question: The Mussalman Wakf (Repeal) Bill, 2024, was introduced in the Lok Sabha on
solution:
The correct answer is __**Thu Aug 08 2024 00:00:00 GMT+0530 (India Standard Time)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Mussalman Wakf (Repeal) Bill, 2024, was introduced in the Lok Sabha on **August 8, 2024**.
 
• The bill seeks to repeal the Mussalman Wakf Act, 1923, which was an outdated legislation.
 
• The introduction of the bill is part of the government's initiative to remove redundant laws.
 
• The bill was introduced by the Ministry of Minority Affairs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Wakf**: A Wakf is a permanent dedication of property by a Muslim for religious, pious, or charitable purposes as recognized by Muslim law.
 
• **Mussalman Wakf Act, 1923**: This act was enacted to provide for the better governance of Wakf properties.
 
• **Repeal of Outdated Laws**: The government periodically reviews and repeals outdated laws to streamline the legal framework.
 
• **Ministry of Minority Affairs**: This ministry is responsible for the development and welfare of minority communities in India.
 
• **Lok Sabha**: The Lok Sabha is the lower house of India's bicameral Parliament, responsible for law-making.
